subject: Scheduling: tri-region technical deep-dive — rotation / split-session options
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Karima Singh <karima@cloudnova.io>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@cloudnova.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: tri-region technical deep-dive — rotation / split-session options

Hi Karima / Tom,

Thanks again for the interest in a deep-dive on the deployment and routing behavior — our architects (Soogin and Marissa) want to make sure we have the right people and enough time. From experience, these sessions run ~60–90 minutes when we cover KV cache warmup, batching tradeoffs, and routing policies.

Constraints you mentioned in the previous call: your EU infra team is only available after 17:00 CEST on weekdays, and APAC architects can only join early mornings AEST. That makes a single overlap tricky, so I wanted to propose two pragmatic options we can pick from:

1) Single rotated core session (90 min) — pick one time each month and rotate so no region always in odd hours.
2) Split session — 60 min core for US+EU, then 30 min follow-up that focuses on APAC-specific configs (shorter, recorded).

Candidate slots (converted to local times; note EU DST change in early May may shift CEST by +1h):
- Thu May 4, 13:00 UTC / 06:00 PDT / 15:00 CEST / 00:00 AEST (next day) — early for APAC but OK for EU
- Fri May 5, 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PDT / 18:00 CEST / 02:00 AEST — later for APAC
- Wed May 10, 11:30 UTC / 04:30 PDT / 13:30 CEST / 21:30 AEST — better APAC evening coverage

I attached proposed_slots.ics with these candidate blocks to make it easy to try. Please reply with which option you prefer (single rotated or split), and which of the candidate slots works — and confirm attendee list (we want 1–2 SEs + 1 infra/arch from your side).

If helpful, I can also run a short 20–30 minute pre-read sync with just the EU architects to iron out high-level constraints before the full deep-dive.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
From: Karima Singh <karima@cloudnova.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@cloudnova.io>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 00:34:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Scheduling: tri-region technical deep-dive — rotation / split-session options

Hi Logan,

Thanks — the options look reasonable. Quick notes from our side:
- Our EU infra architects (Tom + one more) are generally only free after 17:00 CEST on weekdays.
- APAC (Melbourne office) can do early mornings AEST (06:30–09:30) Mon–Thu; evenings after 20:00 AEST are also possible.
- We do have a DST shift the first weekend of May which may shift some of the CEST conversions you listed; please double-check.

Given those constraints, a split session seems most practical: 60 min core + 30 min APAC follow-up. That reduces the number of people who need to be online at odd hours.

Preferred candidate slots from your list:
- Wed May 10, 11:30 UTC — looks promising for APAC evening and EU afternoon.
- If you must do early May, Thu May 4 (13:00 UTC) is OK for EU but will be midnight for our Melbourne team — they'd prefer the May 10 slot.

Attendees: Karima Singh (CloudNova — Product Infra), Tom Becker (CloudNova — Principal Architect), plus Tim Rao (APAC infra lead) for the follow-up.

Please coordinate with Soojin and Marissa on an agenda and whether you want us to share topology/config snippets in advance.

Appreciate it —
Karima
CloudNova
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Karima Singh <karima@cloudnova.io>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@cloudnova.io>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 07:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling: tri-region technical deep-dive — rotation / split-session options

Thanks Karima — and great constraints, that helps a lot.

Agreed: split session is efficient. Proposed session plan:
- 60 min core (US + EU): architecture walkthrough, key performance knobs (batching, caching), KV warmup patterns, and a short Q&A — aim is to align on expected tail-latency and throughput.
- 30 min APAC follow-up: focused on regional routing, GSLB behavior, and any edge cases for warm-starts.

Agenda draft (I'll post to the shared doc once we lock time):
- 0–10m: intros & goals
- 10–35m: architecture + live perf screenshots (what we expect)
- 35–50m: routing / fallback policies
- 50–60m: open Q&A and action items
- +30m follow-up: APAC-specific configs + handshake on testing cadence

I'm attaching a quick timezone-matrix.png that shows per-region local times for the candidate slots (includes DST note). If Wed May 10 11:30 UTC works for everyone, I can schedule the core 60 min and then add a separate 30 min follow-up at a time that matches Tim in Melbourne.

Also: if CloudNova can share a small sample trace or config snippet ahead of time (no sensitive secrets), I can prepare targeted perf numbers to make the session actionable.

- Soojin
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Karima / Tom — thanks, and thanks Soojin.

Plan: we will go with the split-session approach. Tentative schedule (I have added calendar invites — attached as confirmed_invite.ics):

Core session (60 min):
- Wed May 10, 2027 | 11:30 UTC — which is 04:30 PDT / 13:30 CEST / 21:30 AEST (APAC can join late evening)

APAC follow-up (30 min):
- Thu May 11, 2027 | 02:00 UTC — 19:00 PDT (Wed) / 04:00 CEST / 12:00 AEST (Thu) — Tim, please confirm if this local midday AEST works for you; we chose it to avoid midnight for EU architects.

If those two blocks look OK, we'll keep the core session as the canonical recording and treat the APAC follow-up as an operational handoff. Soojin will post a short agenda + request for a sample trace/config ahead of the session.

Karima: attendees we have on the invites are you, Tom, Tim (TBD confirmation), Soojin, Marissa, and myself. If you'd like additional folks, reply-all and we'll expand.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
